evals.prompt: 帮我导入 Attention Is All You Need 这篇论文
evals.expected_output: Run the full pipeline: resolve → acquire. Generate metadata.yaml, download PDF, and convert to paper.md.
expectations: paper-search is called first to resolve the paper identity
metadata.yaml is generated with correct identity and bibliography
paper-acquire is called to download the PDF
paper.md is generated via pdf-to-md normalization
The final folder contains metadata.yaml, paper/paper.pdf, and paper/paper.md

evals.prompt: 帮我确认一下 GAT 这篇论文的身份，不需要下载
evals.expected_output: Run only the resolve step with --no-acquire behavior.
expectations: paper-search is called to resolve the paper identity
metadata.yaml is generated with identity and bibliography
The user is informed of the resolved paper identity

evals.prompt: 帮我把 Geom-GCN 这篇论文全套导入，包括找代码仓库
evals.expected_output: Run the full pipeline including repo discovery: resolve → acquire → repo.
expectations: paper-acquire downloads PDF and generates paper.md
paper-repo searches for and clones the implementation repository
The final folder contains metadata.yaml, paper/, and repo/
The repo_search section in metadata.yaml records the discovery results
